title: AngelScript Engine Rules Configuration
description: JSON schema for AngelScript data-driven engine safety rules and compiler property configurations (angelscript.rules.json).

name.description: Friendly human-readable display name for this engine ruleset.

engineProperties.description: Native AngelScript engine properties (asEP_*) that configure compiler and parser behavior.

propertyAccessorMode.description: asEP_PROPERTY_ACCESSOR_MODE: 0 = disabled, 1 = explicit get/set only, 2 = automatic virtual property getters and setters, 3 = backward compatibility mode.

disallowGlobalVars.description: asEP_DISALLOW_GLOBAL_VARS: When true, prohibits scripts from declaring global variables.

requireEnumScope.description: asEP_REQUIRE_ENUM_SCOPE: When true, enum values must be qualified with the enum scope (EnumName::Value).

boolConversionMode.description: asEP_BOOL_CONVERSION_MODE: 0 = strict bool conversions, 1 = allows conversions from numbers and handles.

allowUnsafeReferences.description: asEP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_REFERENCES: When true, allows unsafe references and pointer syntax.

allowMultilineStrings.description: asEP_ALLOW_MULTILINE_STRINGS: When true, allows multiline string literals.

disableIntegerDivision.description: asEP_DISABLE_INTEGER_DIVISION: When true, integer division results in float values.

storageRules.description: Rules for restricting storage locations of unsafe types (e.g. raw handles in class members or global arrays).

id.description: Unique identifier for this storage safety rule.

types.description: List of exact type names to match.

inheritsFrom.description: Base type name. Any type inheriting from this type will trigger the rule.

typeRegex.description: Regular expression pattern to match type names (e.g. 'CBase.*').

handleOnly.description: If true, the rule only triggers when the type is stored as a handle ('@').

disallowInMembers.description: Prohibit storing matching types in class or struct member variables.

disallowInGlobals.description: Prohibit storing matching types in global variables.

disallowInArrays.description: Prohibit storing matching types as elements of arrays (array<T>).

suggestReplacement.description: Safe replacement type to recommend in the diagnostic message (e.g. 'EHandle').

message.description: Custom diagnostic message template. Supports '{}' formatting placeholders for variable name and suggested replacement.

severity.description: Diagnostic severity reported to the client.

typeSuggestions.description: Suggestions to migrate from discouraged or engine-specific types to safer or standard alternatives.

id.description: Unique identifier for this type suggestion rule.

appliesTo.description: Scopes where this type suggestion should trigger.

severity.description: Diagnostic severity reported to the client.

schedulerRules.description: Rules for validating asynchronous callback registrations and scheduler invocations (e.g. g_Scheduler.SetTimeout).

id.description: Unique identifier for this scheduler safety rule.

receiverTypes.description: Type names of the receiver object (e.g. ['CScheduler']).

disallowParamInheritsFrom.description: Prohibit callback functions having parameters derived from this type.

disallowParamRegex.description: Regex pattern matching parameter types prohibited in scheduled callbacks.

disallowParamHandleOnly.description: If true, only disallow handle parameters in callbacks.

paramSuggestReplacement.description: Safe replacement to suggest for callback parameters (e.g. 'EHandle').

disallowArgInheritsFrom.description: Prohibit passing arguments derived from this type to the scheduler.

disallowArgRegex.description: Regex pattern matching arguments prohibited in scheduled call expressions.

disallowArgHandleOnly.description: If true, only disallow raw handle arguments passed to the scheduler.

argSuggestReplacement.description: Safe replacement to suggest for scheduler arguments (e.g. 'EHandle').

requireExplicitEnumConstruct.description: Warn when integer discriminants are passed to wildcard '?& in' arguments intended for enum parameters without an explicit enum constructor or cast.

severity.description: Diagnostic severity reported to the client.
